items.name: Golden Mask
items.hint: Wearing it makes the ghosts appear.
items.solutionText: The ghosts guide you to the secret door!

items.name: Stage Prop
items.hint: A fake sword made of wood.

description: Bubbles and schools of neon fish.

items.name: Sea Shell
items.hint: It whispers of the deep.

items.name: Ocean Key
items.hint: It unlocks the city's main gate.
items.solutionText: The gate opens to the Royal Palace!

items.name: Sand Dollar
items.hint: A simple beach treasure.

description: Hammers hitting hot iron.

items.name: Burning Coal
items.hint: Too hot to hold.

items.name: Ice Rune
items.hint: It cools the metal instantly.
items.solutionText: The metal hardens into a key!

items.name: Leather Apron
items.hint: Protects you from sparks.

description: Reflective walls and flying cars.

items.name: Laser Tool
items.hint: Used for precision cutting.

items.name: System Override
items.hint: It shuts down the city's security.
items.solutionText: The main terminal opens!

items.name: Synth-Coffee
items.hint: Tastes like electricity.

description: Trees that glow with a soft blue light.

items.name: Silver Bell
items.hint: Its ring is peaceful.

items.name: Ancient Seed
items.hint: Planting this grows a path of light.
items.solutionText: The path leads to the Spirit Tree!

items.name: Glowing Mushroom
items.hint: It tastes like mint and ozone.

description: The peak of magical knowledge.

items.name: Magic Wand
items.hint: It sparks, but nothing happens.

items.name: Master Tome
items.hint: It contains the spell to open the exit.
items.solutionText: The tower walls vanish, leaving you free!

items.name: Crystal Ball
items.hint: It shows a cloudy future.

description: Mountains of old computers and wires.

items.name: Old Keyboard
items.hint: Most of the keys are missing.

items.name: Power Cell
items.hint: It powers up the old crane.
items.solutionText: The crane lifts you over the wall!

items.name: Broken Screen
items.hint: It's cracked and dark.

description: Statues that seem to watch you.

items.name: Stone Tablet
items.hint: Written in a forgotten tongue.

items.name: Golden Lyre
items.hint: The music makes the statues move.
items.solutionText: The statues form a door!

items.name: Silk Ribbon
items.hint: A simple decoration.

description: Thick sludge and croaking frogs.

items.name: Wooden Pole
items.hint: Used for walking in the mud.

items.name: Purifying Salt
items.hint: It clears the toxic water.
items.solutionText: The path to the marsh temple is clear!

items.name: Rusty Hook
items.hint: Good for fishing.

description: Floating debris and distant galaxies.

items.name: Space Dust
items.hint: It shimmers like diamonds.

items.name: Gravity Orb
items.hint: It pulls you toward the exit.
items.solutionText: You are pulled into the portal!

items.name: Broken Satellite
items.hint: A relic of an old world.

description: Cold walls and heavy guards.

items.name: Iron Shield
items.hint: Strong and heavy.

items.name: Secret Pass
items.hint: A whisper that opens the gate.
items.solutionText: The guards let you pass!

items.name: Steel Spike
items.hint: A sharp weapon.

description: White light and rainbow reflections.

items.name: Red Lens
items.hint: Shows only the heat.

items.name: White Diamond
items.hint: It focuses the light into a beam.
items.solutionText: The beam unlocks the door!

items.name: Blue Lens
items.hint: Shows only the cold.

description: Your voice returns to you a thousand times.

items.name: Metal Bell
items.hint: It rings loudly.

items.name: Silence Stone
items.hint: It absorbs all sound.
items.solutionText: The silence reveals the exit!

items.name: Tuning Fork
items.hint: Creates a steady tone.

description: Coral that floats in the air.

items.name: Air Bubble
items.hint: It floats gently upward.

items.name: Ocean Heart
items.hint: Its beat pulls the reef together.
items.solutionText: A bridge of coral forms!

items.name: Sea Shell
items.hint: It echoes the ocean.

description: A tower of light and data.

items.name: Data Cable
items.hint: Pulsing with information.

items.name: Master Key
items.hint: It unlocks the top of the spire.
items.solutionText: You reach the summit of the city!

items.name: Circuit Chip
items.hint: A small piece of hardware.

description: The end of the journey. One last choice.

items.name: Golden Key
items.hint: The key to everything.

items.name: The Truth
items.hint: The realization that the journey was the goal.
items.solutionText: You have ascended beyond the puzzles! Congratulations!

items.name: Silver Key
items.hint: A fine key, but not the right one.
